scope: synthetic G0; one endpoint per call; pooled scales

linear.phaseI: HiGHS: minimum common nonnegative slack on explicit Aq<=b including gain bounds
linear.certificate: exact rational basic dual on float64 Aq<=b; dimension independent; weights sum one
linear.certificateBinding: indices into caller-regenerated constraints; no embedded unbound system
linear.initialUpper: 255-code relaxed measured constraints, never relaxed rails; original forward checked
linear.railRoundoffGuard: candidate only; never used to certify lower; original forward rails still checked exactly

local.baseline: E3/EH6 ones; O12 identity at each of three nodes
local.otherStarts: 15 NumPy default_rng(seed) uniform in full declared parameter box

leastSquares.mass: equal cell mass, then equal uncensored-channel mass within each cell; rails hard, not residuals
leastSquares.rails: unconstrained bounded least_squares seeds SLSQP constrained LS

minimax.initialization: each original start, independently of least-squares
minimax.objective: maximum unweighted uncensored code error; equal mass leaves infinity norm unchanged

local.rejection: optimizer failure, coefficient bounds failure, any positive forward rail deficit, or epigraph gap >1e-8
local.rank: finite-difference raw uncensored predicted channels, scipy approx_derivative with parameter bounds
local.authority: LOCAL candidates only; E3/EH6 global survival and negatives require certified LP

limits: No native fit or archive payload read in G0
No caller role, scale, population, repeat or freeze enforcement in this array module
Censored-bound-satisfied is not RGB accuracy or heldout coverage
